steps.text: Step into your farmhouse and read grandmother's letter
steps.say: Grandma's letter: the farm is yours, and so is my $2000 debt to the Vance family. I'm sorry, dear.
The first seed is in. Grandma would be proud.

steps.text: Earn some cash: sell crops or fish ($700 on hand)
steps.say: Cash in hand. Time to see what the Vances want.
A black car idles at your gate. Mr. Vance leaves a card: 'Town Hall ledger, Port Halden. $2000.'

steps.text: Ask at the Town Hall ledger in Port Halden
steps.say: Clerk: 'The Vance debt is $2000. Pay what you can, in $250 slices.'

steps.text: Pay the first $500 of the debt at the Town Hall ledger
steps.say: First instalment paid. Vance's clerk nods, almost kindly.

steps.text: Look for grandmother's old claim: the Highlands cave
steps.say: Scratched on the rock: 'I reached the Moon first. Vance never knew.'

steps.text: Read the Town Hall notice board: Vance Aerospace is hiring
steps.say: Vance Aerospace wants workers. Their rocket yard is closed to the public.

steps.text: Clear the whole Vance debt at the Town Hall ledger (due day 28, late fees after)
steps.say: DEBT CLEARED. Act 1 complete. Vance Aerospace has noticed you: Act 2 (Earth City) is next.

steps.text: Drive to the Vance Aerospace yard in the far north-east
steps.say: Razor wire, floodlights and a half-built rocket. A man in a grey suit waits by the gate.

steps.text: Talk to Mr. Vance at the yard gate
steps.say: Vance: 'Your grandmother owed me. You paid. Work for me or against me, the Moon is still mine.'

steps.text: Choose your road: honest jobs or street work (10 reputation in either)
steps.say: Word gets around Port Halden. People know which road you walk now.

steps.text: Win a race (1st place) from a start line or at the circuit
steps.say: The chequered flag is yours. Drivers in Port Halden start nodding at your car.

steps.text: Finish a weekly fishing contest at the harbour board
steps.say: The harbour crowd saw your catch. Someone mutters your name.

steps.text: Earn a promotion at any job (press J at a workplace)
steps.say: A new badge and a bigger envelope. The honest town trusts you a little more.
steps.say_street: Your boss grins: 'Good hands. Better not to ask what else they do.'

steps.text: Win a boxing bout at the Sports Hall
steps.say: KO. The Sports Hall will remember the new fighter from the farm.

steps.text: Become known: 25 reputation on either road
steps.say: Honest Port Halden greets you by name; shopkeepers set aside the good stock.
steps.say_street: The back-alley crowd greets you by name; a fence promises better crates.

steps.text: Get onto the Vance launch pad: hold $5000 for a ticket, or fence a smuggled crate for a Vance keycard
steps.say: You have a way onto the launch pad. Grandmother's Moon claim waits: Act 3 (the Moon) is next.

default: Your grandmother had a habit of finding things before I did. I don't like habits.
The rocket? Private property. So is most of this coast.
Honest work pays slowly. I'd know; I own most of it.
If you ever want a seat on that rocket, bring money. Or don't get caught.
